content.json:
# Server Patch & Inventory Compliance

Operational visibility over Arc-enabled and Azure VM Windows estate, focused on **OS / build / CU compliance, reboot status, patch-group cadence, and data freshness**.

Use the filters below, then walk the tabs from **Overview → Data Health** to identify which servers are behind, why, whether they rebooted, whether that's expected, and who needs to act.

> Data sources: Azure Resource Graph (`patchassessmentresources`, `patchinstallationresources`, `Microsoft.HybridCompute/machines`, `Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines`) and Log Analytics (`Heartbeat`, `ConfigurationChange`). Requires Azure Update Manager periodic assessment enabled.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
| where tolower(tostring(properties.osType)) == 'windows' or tolower(tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)) == 'windows'
| summarize by resourceGroup
| order by resourceGroup asc

parameters.name: PatchGroupTag
parameters.label: Patch group tag
parameters.description: Tag name used to mirror your SCCM patch group / collection (e.g. PatchGroup, Collection, MaintenanceWindow). Leave blank if unused.

parameters.name: WindowHours
parameters.label: Maintenance window (hours)
parameters.description: Used by the 'on-time reboot' check on the Reboot tab.

parameters.name: TargetBuilds
parameters.label: Target builds (override)
parameters.description: Optional: pin the latest CU build per OS. Leave blank to let the workbook auto-derive the target from the highest build observed in your estate. Format: comma-separated `'OSVersion','Build'` pairs, e.g. `'Windows Server 2022','10.0.20348.2700','Windows Server 2019','10.0.17763.6189'`. Refresh after each Patch Tuesday from learn.microsoft.com Windows release health.

content.json:
## Overview
Executive snapshot: estate size, compliance %, reboot pending, OS distribution.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
| extend osType = tolower(coalesce(tostring(properties.osType), tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)))
| where osType == 'windows'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| summarize Servers = count()
content.title: Total Windows servers
content.noDataMessage: No Windows servers found in the selected subscriptions or resource groups. Adjust the Subscriptions and Resource groups filters above.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchassessmentresults' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/patchassessmentresults'
| extend machineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0])),
         lastAssessed = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime),
         pending = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.security) + toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.critical)
| summarize arg_max(lastAssessed, pending) by machineId
| summarize Compliant = countif(pending == 0), Total = count()
| extend ["Compliant %"] = iif(Total == 0, todouble(0), round(100.0 * Compliant / Total, 1))
| project ["Compliant %"]
content.title: Critical/Security compliant %
content.noDataMessage: No Critical/Security assessment data yet. Confirm Azure Update Manager periodic assessment is enabled for machines in scope.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchassessmentresults' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/patchassessmentresults'
| extend rebootPending = tobool(properties.rebootPending),
         lastAssessed = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime),
         machineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0]))
| summarize arg_max(lastAssessed, rebootPending) by machineId
| summarize ["Reboot pending"] = countif(rebootPending == true)
content.title: Reboot pending
content.noDataMessage: No reboot-pending data. No machine in scope has returned an assessment yet.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchassessmentresults' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/patchassessmentresults'
| extend machineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0]))
| extend AssessedOn = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime)
| summarize LastAssessed = max(AssessedOn) by machineId
| summarize Stale = countif(LastAssessed < ago(7d))
content.title: Assessment > 7 days stale
content.noDataMessage: No assessment data found for machines in scope, so staleness cannot be evaluated. Confirm periodic assessment is enabled.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
| extend osType = tolower(coalesce(tostring(properties.osType), tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)))
| where osType == 'windows'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend osVersion = tostring(coalesce(properties.osVersion, properties.extended.instanceView.osVersion))
| extend osSku = tostring(coalesce(properties.osSku, properties.extended.instanceView.osName, properties.storageProfile.imageReference.sku, properties.storageProfile.imageReference.offer))
| extend OSVersion = case(
    osVersion startswith '6.3.9600' or osSku has '2012-R2' or osSku has '2012 R2','Windows Server 2012 R2',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.14393' or osSku has '2016','Windows Server 2016',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.17763' or osSku has '2019','Windows Server 2019',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.20348' or osSku has '2022','Windows Server 2022',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.26100' or osSku has '2025','Windows Server 2025',
    iif(isempty(osSku),'Unknown', osSku))
| summarize Servers = count() by OSVersion
| order by Servers desc
content.title: Servers by Windows Server version
content.noDataMessage: No Windows servers found in scope. Adjust the Subscriptions or Resource groups filters.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchassessmentresults' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/patchassessmentresults'
| extend machineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0]))
| extend AssessedOn = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime)
| summarize arg_max(AssessedOn, properties) by machineId
| extend Cls = properties.availablePatchCountByClassification
| extend Critical = toint(coalesce(Cls.critical, 0)),
         Security = toint(coalesce(Cls.security, 0)),
         UpdateRollups = toint(coalesce(Cls.updateRollup, 0)),
         Other = toint(coalesce(Cls.definition, 0)) + toint(coalesce(Cls.featurePack, 0)) + toint(coalesce(Cls.servicePack, 0)) + toint(coalesce(Cls.tools, 0)) + toint(coalesce(Cls.updates, 0))
| summarize Critical = sum(Critical), Security = sum(Security), UpdateRollups = sum(UpdateRollups), Other = sum(Other)
| project Classification = pack_array('Critical','Security','UpdateRollups','Other'), Count = pack_array(Critical, Security, UpdateRollups, Other)
| mv-expand Classification to typeof(string), Count to typeof(long)
| where Count > 0
content.title: Pending updates by classification
content.noDataMessage: No pending updates. Every assessed machine in scope is fully patched, or no assessment data has been returned yet.

content.json:
## OS & Build Inventory
Drill from OS version → build number → individual server. The **last segment** of the build number (the four-digit revision) reflects the cumulative update level.

resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
| extend osType = tolower(coalesce(tostring(properties.osType), tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)))
| where osType == 'windows'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend osVersion = tostring(coalesce(properties.osVersion, properties.extended.instanceView.osVersion))
| extend osSku = tostring(coalesce(properties.osSku, properties.extended.instanceView.osName, properties.storageProfile.imageReference.sku, properties.storageProfile.imageReference.offer))
| extend OSVersion = case(
    osVersion startswith '6.3.9600' or osSku has '2012-R2' or osSku has '2012 R2','Windows Server 2012 R2',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.14393' or osSku has '2016','Windows Server 2016',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.17763' or osSku has '2019','Windows Server 2019',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.20348' or osSku has '2022','Windows Server 2022',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.26100' or osSku has '2025','Windows Server 2025',
    iif(isempty(osSku),'Unknown', osSku))
| summarize Servers = count() by OSVersion
| extend Order = case(OSVersion == 'Windows Server 2012 R2', 0, OSVersion == 'Windows Server 2016', 1, OSVersion == 'Windows Server 2019', 2, OSVersion == 'Windows Server 2022', 3, OSVersion == 'Windows Server 2025', 4, 5)
| order by Order asc

content.json:
## CU Compliance
Every server must be on the latest build per OS family **and** have zero pending Critical, Security, or UpdateRollups updates reported by Azure Update Manager. Anything else is Non-compliant.

> **`TargetBuild` defaults to the highest build observed in your estate** per OS family (column `TargetSource` shows `estate`). To pin to Microsoft's published Patch Tuesday build instead, fill in the **Target builds (override)** parameter above with `'<OSVersion>','<Build>'` pairs — those rows will show `TargetSource = override`.
>
> Azure Resource Graph and Update Manager don't expose the *currently published* CU build per OS as a queryable field, so the override is how you keep this in sync with the Microsoft release cycle.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
| extend osType = tolower(coalesce(tostring(properties.osType), tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)))
| where osType == 'windows'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend osName = tostring(coalesce(properties.osName, properties.osProfile.windowsConfiguration.osName))
| extend osVersion = tostring(coalesce(properties.osVersion, properties.osProfile.windowsConfiguration.osVersion))
| extend OSVersion = case(
    osVersion startswith '10.0.14393' or osName has '2016','Windows Server 2016',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.17763' or osName has '2019','Windows Server 2019',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.20348' or osName has '2022','Windows Server 2022',
    osVersion startswith '10.0.26100' or osName has '2025','Windows Server 2025',
    osVersion startswith '6.3.9600','Windows Server 2012 R2',
    'Other')
| extend PatchGroup = tostring(tags['{PatchGroupTag}']),
         MachineId = tolower(id),
         Server = name,
         RG = resourceGroup,
         Build = iif(isempty(osVersion),'Unknown', osVersion)
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
    | extend osType = tolower(coalesce(tostring(properties.osType), tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)))
    | where osType == 'windows'
    | extend osName = tostring(coalesce(properties.osName, properties.osProfile.windowsConfiguration.osName))
    | extend osVersion = tostring(coalesce(properties.osVersion, properties.osProfile.windowsConfiguration.osVersion))
    | extend OSVersion = case(
        osVersion startswith '10.0.14393' or osName has '2016','Windows Server 2016',
        osVersion startswith '10.0.17763' or osName has '2019','Windows Server 2019',
        osVersion startswith '10.0.20348' or osName has '2022','Windows Server 2022',
        osVersion startswith '10.0.26100' or osName has '2025','Windows Server 2025',
        osVersion startswith '6.3.9600','Windows Server 2012 R2',
        'Other')
    | where isnotempty(osVersion)
    | summarize EstateMax = max(osVersion) by OSVersion
    | join kind=leftouter (datatable(OSVersion:string, OverrideBuild:string) [ {TargetBuilds} ]) on OSVersion
    | extend TargetBuild = coalesce(OverrideBuild, EstateMax), TargetSource = iif(isnotempty(OverrideBuild),'override','estate')
    | project OSVersion, TargetBuild, TargetSource
) on OSVersion
| join kind=leftouter (
    patchassessmentresources
    | where type endswith 'patchassessmentresults/softwarepatches'
    | extend MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0]))
    | extend Cls = tostring(properties.classifications[0])
    | where Cls in ('Critical','Security','UpdateRollups')
    | summarize PendingSecurityUpdates = count() by MachineId
) on MachineId
| extend PendingSecurityUpdates = coalesce(PendingSecurityUpdates, 0)
| extend Status = case(
    PendingSecurityUpdates > 0, 'Non-compliant (missing updates)',
    Build == TargetBuild, 'Compliant',
    'Non-compliant (behind)')
| project Server, ResourceGroup = RG, OSVersion, Build, TargetBuild, TargetSource, PendingSecurityUpdates, PatchGroup, Status, MachineId
content.title: CU compliance by server
content.noDataMessage: No servers to evaluate. No Windows machines in scope, or no assessment data has been returned yet.

    | extend OSVersion = case(
        osVersion startswith '10.0.14393' or osName has '2016','Windows Server 2016',
        osVersion startswith '10.0.17763' or osName has '2019','Windows Server 2019',
        osVersion startswith '10.0.20348' or osName has '2022','Windows Server 2022',
        osVersion startswith '10.0.26100' or osName has '2025','Windows Server 2025',
        osVersion startswith '6.3.9600','Windows Server 2012 R2',
        'Other')
    | where isnotempty(osVersion)
    | summarize EstateMax = max(osVersion) by OSVersion
    | join kind=leftouter (datatable(OSVersion:string, OverrideBuild:string) [ {TargetBuilds} ]) on OSVersion
    | extend TargetBuild = coalesce(OverrideBuild, EstateMax)
    | project OSVersion, TargetBuild
) on OSVersion
| join kind=leftouter (
    patchassessmentresources
    | where type endswith 'patchassessmentresults/softwarepatches'
    | extend MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0]))
    | extend Cls = tostring(properties.classifications[0])
    | where Cls in ('Critical','Security','UpdateRollups')
    | summarize PendingSecurityUpdates = count() by MachineId
) on MachineId
| extend PendingSecurityUpdates = coalesce(PendingSecurityUpdates, 0)
| extend IsCompliant = (PendingSecurityUpdates == 0) and (Build == TargetBuild)
| summarize Servers = count(), CompliantCount = countif(IsCompliant) by OSVersion
| extend ["Compliant %"] = iif(Servers == 0, todouble(0), round(100.0 * CompliantCount / Servers, 1))
| project OSVersion, Servers, Compliant = CompliantCount, ["Compliant %"]
| order by ["Compliant %"] asc
content.title: Compliance by OS version — % of servers on target build with zero pending Critical/Security updates

| where isnotempty(osVersion)
| extend CurrentRev = toint(tostring(split(osVersion,'.')[3]))
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
    | extend osVersion = tostring(coalesce(properties.osVersion, properties.extended.instanceView.osVersion))

    | summarize TargetRev = max(Rev) by OSVersion
) on OSVersion
| extend Drift = TargetRev - CurrentRev
| extend Bucket = case(Drift == 0,'0 — on target', Drift between (1 .. 1),'1 revision behind', Drift between (2 .. 3),'2-3 revisions behind', Drift between (4 .. 6),'4-6 revisions behind','7+ revisions behind')

| order by OSVersion asc

content.json:
## Reboot Compliance
Separates **installed** from **installed and rebooted**. 'On-time' means reboot completed within the maintenance window ({WindowHours}h) of the install.

content.query:
patchinstallationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchinstallationresults' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/patchinstallationresults'
| extend machineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchInstallationResults/')[0]))
| extend RunTime = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime),
         Status = tostring(properties.status),
         RebootStatus = tostring(properties.rebootStatus),
         Installed = toint(properties.installedPatchCount),
         Failed = toint(properties.failedPatchCount),
         Pending = toint(properties.pendingPatchCount)
| where RunTime > todatetime('{Lookback:startISO}')
| summarize arg_max(RunTime, Status, RebootStatus, Installed, Failed, Pending) by machineId
| extend Server = tostring(split(machineId, '/')[8])
| project Server, Status, RebootStatus, Installed, Failed, Pending, LastRun = RunTime, machineId
| order by LastRun desc
content.title: Install + reboot status by server (last {Lookback:label})
content.noDataMessage: No patch runs in the selected lookback window. Widen the Patch lookback filter, or no installation has run yet.

content.query:
patchinstallationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchinstallationresults' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/patchinstallationresults'
| extend machineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchInstallationResults/')[0]))
| extend StartedOn = todatetime(properties.startDateTime),
         CompletedOn = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime),
         Status = tostring(properties.status),
         RebootStatus = tostring(properties.rebootStatus)
| where StartedOn > todatetime('{Lookback:startISO}')
| extend OnTime = (CompletedOn - StartedOn) <= ({WindowHours}h)
| summarize Runs = count(),
            Succeeded = countif(Status =~ 'Succeeded'),
            RebootCompleted = countif(RebootStatus =~ 'Completed'),
            OnTimeRuns = countif(OnTime and RebootStatus =~ 'Completed') by bin(StartedOn, 1d)
| order by StartedOn asc
content.title: Patch runs & on-time reboots over time
content.noDataMessage: No patch runs in the selected lookback window to chart. Widen the Patch lookback filter.

content.json:
## Pending Updates
Everything Azure Update Manager has assessed as **not yet installed**. Use this as your queue: which KBs are sitting unapplied, how many machines need each one, and how long they've been outstanding.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchassessmentresults' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/patchassessmentresults'
| extend Cls = properties.availablePatchCountByClassification
| extend MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0])),
         LastAssessed = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime),
         Critical = toint(coalesce(Cls.critical, 0)),
         Security = toint(coalesce(Cls.security, 0)),
         UpdateRollups = toint(coalesce(Cls.updateRollup, 0)),
         Other = toint(coalesce(Cls.definition, 0)) + toint(coalesce(Cls.featurePack, 0)) + toint(coalesce(Cls.servicePack, 0)) + toint(coalesce(Cls.tools, 0)) + toint(coalesce(Cls.updates, 0)),
         RebootPending = tobool(properties.rebootPending)
| summarize arg_max(LastAssessed, *) by MachineId
| extend TotalPending = Critical + Security + UpdateRollups + Other
| where TotalPending > 0 or RebootPending == true
| join kind=leftouter (resources | where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines') | extend MachineId = tolower(id) | project MachineId, Server = name, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, PatchGroup = tostring(tags['{PatchGroupTag}']), Owner = tostring(tags['Owner'])) on MachineId
| project Server, ResourceGroup, PatchGroup, Owner, Critical, Security, UpdateRollups, Other, TotalPending, RebootPending, LastAssessed, MachineId
| order by Critical desc, Security desc, TotalPending desc
content.title: Pending updates by server
content.noDataMessage: No pending updates and nothing awaiting reboot. Every assessed machine in scope is fully patched.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| where type endswith 'patchassessmentresults/softwarepatches'
| extend MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0])),
         PatchName    = tostring(properties.patchName),
         KBId         = tostring(properties.kbId),
         Classification = tostring(properties.classifications[0]),
         Published    = todatetime(coalesce(properties.publishedDate, properties.lastModifiedDateTime))
| extend Label = strcat(iif(isempty(KBId),'',strcat('KB', KBId, ' — ')), PatchName)
| summarize Machines = dcount(MachineId), FirstSeen = min(Published), LastSeen = max(Published), Classifications = make_set(Classification) by Label
| extend AgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), FirstSeen)
| order by Machines desc
| take 25
content.title: Top pending KBs across the estate (machines awaiting each KB)
content.noDataMessage: No pending KBs. Every assessed machine in scope is fully patched, or no assessment data has been returned yet.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| where type endswith 'patchassessmentresults/softwarepatches'
| extend Classification = tostring(properties.classifications[0])
| where isnotempty(Classification)
| summarize Pending = count() by Classification
| order by Pending desc
content.title: Pending updates by classification
content.noDataMessage: No pending updates. Every assessed machine in scope is fully patched.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| where type endswith 'patchassessmentresults/softwarepatches'
| extend PatchName    = tostring(properties.patchName),
         KBId         = tostring(properties.kbId),
         Classification = tostring(properties.classifications[0]),
         Published    = todatetime(coalesce(properties.publishedDate, properties.lastModifiedDateTime)),
         MachineId    = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0]))
| where Classification in ('Critical','Security','UpdateRollups')
| where Published > ago(45d)
| extend Label = strcat(iif(isempty(KBId),'',strcat('KB', KBId, ' — ')), PatchName)
| summarize Machines = dcount(MachineId), Published = min(Published) by Label, Classification
| extend AgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), Published)
| order by Published desc
content.title: Recently published pending KBs (last 45 days, Critical/Security/UpdateRollups) — candidate signal for a new Microsoft CU
content.noDataMessage: No newly published pending KBs in the last 45 days. No recent Critical/Security/UpdateRollups updates are outstanding.

content.json:
## Failures
What did Azure Update Manager **try** to install, and what failed? Top row shows run-level failures with the error returned by the agent; second row drills into the individual KBs that didn't install, so you can see whether a single update is blocking a whole patch group or whether it's a one-off.

content.query:
patchinstallationresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines/patchinstallationresults' or type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/patchinstallationresults'
| extend MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchInstallationResults/')[0]))
| extend StartedOn = todatetime(properties.startDateTime),
         CompletedOn = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime),
         Status = tostring(properties.status),
         RebootStatus = tostring(properties.rebootStatus),
         Installed = toint(properties.installedPatchCount),
         Failed    = toint(properties.failedPatchCount),
         Pending   = toint(properties.pendingPatchCount),
         Excluded  = toint(properties.excludedPatchCount),
         ErrorCode = tostring(properties.errorDetails.code),
         ErrorMessage = tostring(properties.errorDetails.message)
| where StartedOn > todatetime('{Lookback:startISO}')
| summarize arg_max(StartedOn, *) by MachineId
| where Status !~ 'Succeeded' or Failed > 0
| extend Expected = Installed + Failed + Pending + Excluded
| join kind=leftouter (resources | where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines') | extend MachineId = tolower(id) | project MachineId, Server = name, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, PatchGroup = tostring(tags['{PatchGroupTag}']), Owner = tostring(tags['Owner'])) on MachineId
| project Server, ResourceGroup, PatchGroup, Owner, StartedOn, CompletedOn, Status, RebootStatus, Expected, Installed, Failed, Pending, Excluded, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, MachineId
| order by StartedOn desc
content.title: Run-level failures (last {Lookback:label})
content.noDataMessage: No failures found — every assessed run in this window installed successfully.

content.query:
patchinstallationresources
| where type endswith 'patchinstallationresults/softwarepatches'
| extend RunId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/softwarePatches/')[0])),
         MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchInstallationResults/')[0]))
| extend PatchName     = tostring(properties.patchName),
         KBId          = tostring(properties.kbId),
         Classification= tostring(properties.classifications[0]),
         PatchStatus   = tostring(properties.status),
         InstallState  = tostring(properties.installationState),
         LastModified  = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime)
| where LastModified > todatetime('{Lookback:startISO}')
| where PatchStatus !~ 'Installed' and InstallState !~ 'Installed'
| join kind=leftouter (resources | where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines') | extend MachineId = tolower(id) | project MachineId, Server = name, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, PatchGroup = tostring(tags['{PatchGroupTag}'])) on MachineId
| project LastModified, Server, ResourceGroup, PatchGroup, PatchName, KBId, Classification, PatchStatus, InstallState, MachineId, RunId
| order by LastModified desc
content.title: Per-patch failures — KBs that didn't install
content.noDataMessage: No failures found — no KBs failed to install in this window.

content.query:
patchinstallationresources
| where type endswith 'patchinstallationresults/softwarepatches'
| extend PatchName    = tostring(properties.patchName),
         KBId         = tostring(properties.kbId),
         PatchStatus  = tostring(properties.status),
         InstallState = tostring(properties.installationState),
         LastModified = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime)
| where LastModified > todatetime('{Lookback:startISO}')
| where PatchStatus =~ 'Failed' or InstallState =~ 'Failed'
| extend Label = strcat(iif(isempty(KBId),'',strcat('KB', KBId, ' — ')), PatchName)
| summarize Failures = count() by Label
| top 15 by Failures
content.title: Top failing KBs (last {Lookback:label})
content.noDataMessage: No failures found — nothing failed to install in this window.

content.json:
## Patch Groups / Collections
Mirrors the existing SCCM patch group model via the **`{PatchGroupTag}`** tag. Use this view to identify which collections aren't keeping cadence.

> **Not using tags yet?** Everything will appear under a single `(untagged)` row — that's your estate-wide baseline. As you start tagging machines with `{PatchGroupTag}=<collection>`, they'll segment into separate rows automatically.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
| extend osType = tolower(coalesce(tostring(properties.osType), tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)))
| where osType == 'windows'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend PatchGroupRaw = tostring(tags['{PatchGroupTag}']), Owner = tostring(tags['Owner']), MachineId = tolower(id), Server = name
| extend PatchGroup = iif(isempty(PatchGroupRaw),'(untagged)', PatchGroupRaw)
| join kind=leftouter (
    patchassessmentresources
    | extend MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0])),
             Pending  = toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.critical) + toint(properties.availablePatchCountByClassification.security),
             RPending = tobool(properties.rebootPending),
             LastAssessed = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime)
    | summarize arg_max(LastAssessed, Pending, RPending) by MachineId
) on MachineId
| summarize Servers = count(),
            CompliantCount = countif(Pending == 0),
            RebootPendingCount = countif(RPending == true),
            Stale = countif(isnull(LastAssessed) or LastAssessed < ago(7d))
        by PatchGroup, Owner
| extend ["Compliant %"] = iif(Servers == 0, todouble(0), round(100.0 * CompliantCount / Servers, 1))
| project PatchGroup, Owner, Servers, ["Compliant %"], CompliantCount, RebootPendingCount, Stale
| order by ["Compliant %"] asc
content.title: Compliance by patch group
content.noDataMessage: No servers to group. No Windows machines in scope. As you tag machines with the patch-group tag they will appear here.

content.json:
## Data Health
Prove the plumbing is trustworthy before trusting the compliance numbers. Everything here rides on the **Arc Connected Machine agent** — if it is disconnected, expired, or running an old version, Update Manager assessment data goes stale and every compliance figure above becomes unreliable.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend Status = tostring(properties.status), LastSeen = todatetime(properties.lastStatusChange)
| summarize Servers = count() by Status
| order by Servers desc
content.title: Arc connection status
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled machines found in scope. This view covers Azure Arc servers only, not Azure VMs.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend Status = tostring(properties.status), LastSeen = todatetime(properties.lastStatusChange)
| where Status =~ 'Disconnected'
| project Server = name, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, ["Last seen"] = LastSeen, id
| order by ["Last seen"] asc
content.title: Disconnected Arc machines
content.noDataMessage: No disconnected machines — all Arc agents are connected.

content.query:
patchassessmentresources
| extend MachineId = tolower(tostring(split(id, '/patchAssessmentResults/')[0])), LastAssessed = todatetime(properties.lastModifiedDateTime)
| summarize LastAssessed = max(LastAssessed) by MachineId
| extend Bucket = case(LastAssessed > ago(1d),'< 1 day', LastAssessed > ago(7d),'1-7 days', LastAssessed > ago(30d),'7-30 days','> 30 days / never')
| summarize Servers = count() by Bucket
content.title: Update Manager scan freshness
content.noDataMessage: No assessment scans found for machines in scope. Confirm Update Manager periodic assessment is enabled.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend Status = tostring(properties.status), AgentVersion = iif(isempty(tostring(properties.agentVersion)),'Unknown', tostring(properties.agentVersion)), LastSeen = todatetime(properties.lastStatusChange)
| project AgentVersion, Server = name, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, Status, LastSeen, id
| order by AgentVersion desc, Server asc
content.title: Arc agent health — drill: agent version → machine
content.noDataMessage: No Arc-enabled machines found in scope. This view covers Azure Arc servers only, not Azure VMs.

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.hybridcompute/machines','microsoft.compute/virtualmachines')
| extend osType = tolower(coalesce(tostring(properties.osType), tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType)))
| where osType == 'windows'
| where '*' in~ ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend HasPatchGroup = isnotempty(tostring(tags['{PatchGroupTag}'])),
         HasOwner      = isnotempty(tostring(tags['Owner']))
| summarize Servers = count(),
            ["{PatchGroupTag} tagged"] = countif(HasPatchGroup),
            ["Owner tagged"]            = countif(HasOwner)
| extend ["Group coverage %"] = round(100.0 * ["{PatchGroupTag} tagged"] / Servers, 1),
         ["Owner coverage %"] = round(100.0 * ["Owner tagged"] / Servers, 1)
| project Servers, ["Group coverage %"], ["Owner coverage %"]
content.title: Tag coverage (track adoption of {PatchGroupTag} / Owner)
content.noDataMessage: No Windows servers found in scope to measure tag coverage against.
